convert_consistency_model_to_diffusers: convert a consistency model checkpoint to diffusers format using the CLI with --unet_path and --dump_path arguments
run_con_pt_to_diffuser: run the con_pt_to_diffuser function to convert a PyTorch checkpoint to a diffusers state dict
convert_resnet_layer: convert a resnet layer from the original checkpoint format to the diffusers format with optional skip connection
convert_attention_layer: convert an attention layer by splitting qkv weights into separate query, key, and value projections
review_unet_config: review the UNet configuration dictionaries for ImageNet64, LSUN256, or test models to understand architecture parameters
